## Core EVM Metrics

### Primary EVM Values
| Metric | Symbol | Value | Definition |
|--------|--------|-------|------------|
| **Planned Value** | PV | $[Amount] | Budgeted cost of work scheduled |
| **Earned Value** | EV | $[Amount] | Budgeted cost of work performed |
| **Actual Cost** | AC | $[Amount] | Actual cost of work performed |
| **Budget at Completion** | BAC | $[Amount] | Total project budget |

### Performance Indices
| Index | Formula | Current Value | Status | Interpretation |
|-------|---------|---------------|--------|----------------|
| **Schedule Performance Index** | EV ÷ PV | [0.XX] | 🔴🟡🟢 | \u003c0.95: Behind, ≥0.95: On track |
| **Cost Performance Index** | EV ÷ AC | [0.XX] | 🔴🟡🟢 | \u003c0.95: Over budget, ≥0.95: On budget |
| **Schedule Compliance Index** | SPI × SCI | [0.XX] | 🔴🟡🟢 | Combined schedule performance |
| **To Complete Performance Index** | (BAC - EV) ÷ (BAC - AC) | [0.XX] | 🔴🟡🟢 | Required efficiency for remaining work |

### Variance Analysis
| Variance | Formula | Current Value | Status | Impact |
|----------|---------|---------------|--------|--------|
| **Schedule Variance** | EV - PV | $[Amount] | 🔴🟡🟢 | Negative = behind schedule |
| **Cost Variance** | EV - AC | $[Amount] | 🔴🟡🟢 | Negative = over budget |
| **Variance at Completion** | BAC - EAC | $[Amount] | 🔴🟡🟢 | Expected final variance |

---

## Forecasting and Projections

### Estimate at Completion (EAC) Analysis
| EAC Method | Formula | Value | Use Case |
|------------|---------|-------|----------|
| **Current Performance Continues** | AC + ((BAC - EV) ÷ CPI) | $[Amount] | Current cost trends continue |
| **Schedule Impact Included** | AC + ((BAC - EV) ÷ (CPI × SPI)) | $[Amount] | Both cost and schedule issues |
| **Bottom-Up Re-estimate** | AC + Remaining Work Estimate | $[Amount] | New detailed estimate |
| **Management Forecast** | AC + Management ETC | $[Amount] | Management judgment |

### Completion Projections
| Projection | Current Estimate | Original Plan | Variance |
|------------|------------------|---------------|----------|
| **Estimated Completion Date** | [Date] | [Date] | [Days early/late] |
| **Estimated Final Cost** | $[Amount] | $[Amount] | $[Over/Under budget] |
| **Time to Complete** | [Days/Weeks] | [Days/Weeks] | [Variance] |

## When to Use

Use throughout the project lifecycle to identify, assess, and track risks. This template is essential for projects with significant complexity, multiple stakeholders, or high business impact, where structured risk management provides decision-making value.

## When NOT to Use

Do not use for very low-risk, short-duration tasks where informal risk awareness is sufficient. Avoid this template if your governance framework requires a different risk management approach or if stakeholders prefer real-time risk dashboards over static registers.
